name: findaphd
title_zh: 先问清你研究底色再开列的导师匹配器
tagline_zh: 不靠关键词瞎猜，先访谈你的方向与履历，再从 OpenAlex 近三年论文里挖真在招人的导师，附主页。
tagline_en: No keyword guessing—it interviews your background, then mines recent OpenAlex papers for active advisors with.
desc_en: This skill should be used when a student asks to "find a PhD advisor", "find professors for my PhD", "match me with supervisors", "who should I apply to for a PhD", "which labs fit my background", or runs /findaphd. It interviews the student (or reads a dropped resume), discovers professors from recent papers via OpenAlex, enriches each one with homepage, ORCID and grant data using parallel subage
why_zh: 它把「找导师」从查名单变成双向校准：先摸清你的研究底色，再反向匹配论文活跃度。
why_en: Turns advisor hunting into two-way calibration: first maps your research DNA, then matches against paper-level activity—saves.
limit_zh: 只覆盖理工科论文库（OpenAlex）收录的领域；不查导师人品、经费是否真到账、实验室氛围。产出是候选清单+佐证链接。
limit_en: Covers only fields indexed in OpenAlex; no PI personality, fund availability, or lab culture checks. Outputs ranked list with evidence links—no.
title_en: PhD advisor matcher that interviews your research base first
